description: Run the Skill Development Pipeline (Test → Optimize → Production) on a skill. Streams stage results into skill_pipeline_runs. Returns { run_id, status, version_after }. Use pipeline.status to watch progress. Requires MODELBOUND_API_KEY.

apply_optimization.description: If true, apply the optimization in the Test stage; otherwise dry-run only.

override_gates.description: Bypass readiness/latency/test gates. Surface this prominently in any UI.

targets.description: e.g. ['marketplace', 'claude']. Production stage publishes to each target after gates pass.

name: pipeline.run
